main.description: Register a service to be notified of writes. On a space host, subscribes to all repos in the space; on a repo host with a `repo`, subscribes to that repo only. Authenticated with a space credential. Prefer `service`: the registering service is named by its service identifier rather than a bare URL, because notifyWrite is delivered with service auth addressed to that identifier and the delivery endpoint is resolved from the service's DID document. `endpoint` is deprecated and kept only for callers that predate `service`.

repo.description: The DID of a specific repo to subscribe to (repo host). Omit to subscribe to the whole space (space host).

service.description: Service identifier of the subscriber: a DID with an optional service fragment naming the entry in its DID document to deliver to (e.g. 'did:web:syncer.example.com#habitat_space_syncer'). notifyWrite calls are addressed to this identifier, and the delivery endpoint is resolved from the service's DID document. Takes precedence over the deprecated `endpoint` when both are given; one of the two is required.

endpoint.description: Deprecated: the endpoint to which notifyWrite events should be delivered. Superseded by `service`, which resolves the delivery endpoint from the service's DID document and addresses notifications to the service identifier instead of this URL.

errors.name: ServiceNotResolvable
errors.description: The service identifier could not be resolved to a DID document with a matching service endpoint.
